S: Fried pork roll, fried egg and American cheese on a soft roll
Thick slices of pork roll fried until the edges curl, stacked on soft rolls with fried egg and cheese.
Wedding day devilled eggs with crisp ham

Eggs boiled and halved, yolks whipped with mayo, mustard and a dash of hot sauce, piped back and topped with crisp fried ham, paprika and chives. Boil 8 eggs for 10 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Halve and mash the yolks with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp Dijon, a dash of hot sauce, salt and pepper until smooth. Dice 100g leg ham finely and fry in a dry pan until crisp. Pipe the yolk mix back into the whites, top with the crisp ham, a dusting of paprika and chopped chives.
Provolone, chargrilled eggplant, olive and roasted pepper skewers with Italian bread and oil
Cubes of provolone threaded with chargrilled eggplant, olives and strips of roasted capsicum, with crusty bread and olive oil.

M: Crispy chicken thigh tossed in a honey and soy glaze, with sesame
Chicken thigh pieces battered and fried crisp, tossed in a honey and soy glaze, with sesame and steamed rice.
Dinner at Pei-Pei's family restaurant, fortunes to follow
Rump strips seared hard in the wok with onion, capsicum and gai lan, tossed in a black pepper and oyster sauce glaze, over jasmine rice.
Clove studded leg ham glazed with honey, brown sugar and Dijon

A smoked leg ham with a sticky honey, brown sugar and pineapple glaze, served with crunchy roast potatoes and a pineapple salsa. Remove the rind from a 2.5kg half leg ham, score the fat and stud with cloves. Simmer 120ml honey, 60g brown sugar, 2 tbsp Dijon mustard and 100ml pineapple juice until syrupy. Bake the ham at 180C for 45 minutes, brushing with glaze every 15 minutes. Roast 1kg halved potatoes in oil alongside. Dice half a pineapple with 1 red chilli, mint and lime juice for the salsa. Slice the ham and serve.
Brown butter, toasted almonds and lemon. Vic Frohmeyer will check
Green beans blanched bright, tossed in nutty brown butter with toasted flaked almonds, lemon zest and salt.
S: Cheddar and cream cheese ball rolled in mozzarella, with crackers

Two cheese balls of cream cheese and cheddar stacked into a snowman, rolled in grated mozzarella, with olive buttons and a carrot nose. Beat 375g soft cream cheese with 150g grated cheddar, 2 tbsp chopped chives and 1/2 tsp garlic powder. Chill 30 minutes, then shape into one large and one small ball. Roll both in 100g finely grated mozzarella and stack on a platter. Press in sliced black olives for eyes and buttons, a small carrot stick for the nose and 2 pretzel sticks for arms. Chill until serving and surround with 250g crackers.
Cooked king prawns with lime and a hot sauce Marie Rose

Chilled king prawns on crisp lettuce with a lime and chilli Marie Rose sauce, avocado and a sprinkle of paprika. Peel 600g cooked king prawns, leaving the tails on. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 3 tbsp tomato sauce, the juice of 1 lime, a few drops of hot sauce and 1 tsp Worcestershire. Shred 1 baby cos lettuce into 4 glasses and add a few cubes of avocado. Spoon over the sauce, then hang the prawns around the rims. Dust with paprika and serve with lime wedges.

M: Beef mince and tomato lasagne layered with white sauce
Beef lasagne with a bubbling cheesy top, comfort food for the night before everything goes wrong.
Engel house fennel and apple salad
Shaved fennel, apple, rocket and parmesan. Fresh before the storm hits
Fennel and green apple shaved thin, tossed with rocket, shaved parmesan and a sharp lemon and mustard dressing.
Beef meatloaf wrapped in bacon and baked until glazed

Juicy beef meatloaf wrapped in streaky bacon and glazed with sticky tomato and brown sugar, served with creamy mash and gravy. Mix 800g beef mince with 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs soaked in 80ml milk, 2 tsp Worcestershire and salt. Shape into a loaf on a lined tray and wrap with 8 rashers streaky bacon. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes, brush with 4 tbsp tomato sauce mixed with 1 tbsp brown sugar and bake 15 minutes more. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and milk. Make gravy from the tray juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml beef stock.
Christmas Eve garlic mash and green beans
Butter mash and beans with crisp shallots, for under the meatloaf
Potatoes mashed with butter, milk and roasted garlic, with green beans and crisp fried shallots on top.
Frost family roast beef and Yorkshires
Mustard rosemary roast beef, roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and gravy

Herb-crusted roast beef with puffed Yorkshire puddings, crunchy roast potatoes, honey carrots and a jug of rich gravy. Rub a 1.5kg beef topside with mustard, rosemary and salt and roast at 200C for 1 hour for medium rare, with 1.2kg parboiled potatoes in oil on another tray. Rest 15 minutes. Turn the oven to 220C. Whisk 2 eggs, 100g plain flour and 150ml milk. Heat 1 tsp oil in each of 8 muffin holes for 5 minutes, pour in the batter and bake 20 minutes without opening. Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 400ml stock.
Snow day maple roast carrots and sprouts
Maple, butter and thyme, roasted while the snow piles up
Carrots and halved brussels sprouts roasted hot until caramelised, glazed with maple syrup, butter and thyme.
Tuohy Thanksgiving turkey at the table
Herb butter roast turkey breast with cornbread stuffing

Herb roast turkey breast with cornbread stuffing, creamy mash, buttery green beans, gravy and cranberry sauce. Push 60g herb butter under the skin of a 1.5kg turkey breast and roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Crumble 300g cornbread with 1 fried onion, 2 celery sticks, chopped sage, 1 egg and 150ml stock and bake 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with butter and milk. Blanch 300g green beans and toss in butter. Make gravy from the juices with 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock. Serve with cranberry sauce.
Three cheeses and a golden top. Big Mike gets a seat at the table
Macaroni in a cheddar, gruyère and cream cheese sauce, baked under buttered crumbs until bubbling and golden.
Chicken braised in garlic, vinegar, soy and bay leaves

Chicken thighs braised in vinegar, soy, garlic, bay and black pepper until sticky and glossy, served with garlic fried rice and a fried egg. Brown 1kg bone-in chicken thighs in 1 tbsp oil. Add 8 crushed garlic cloves, 120ml white vinegar, 80ml soy, 3 bay leaves, 1 tsp black peppercorns and 200ml water. Simmer uncovered for 40 minutes, turning, until the sauce is sticky. Fry 600g cold cooked rice with 4 crushed garlic cloves in 2 tbsp oil until crisp in spots. Fry 4 eggs. Serve the adobo over the rice with an egg on top.
Sinangag, crisp garlic and day-old rice, for the adobo sauce
Day-old rice fried hot with plenty of garlic cooked golden, finished with spring onion and a fried egg on top.
Crumbed pork fillet in a soft bun with pickles and slaw

Iowa's famous oversized crumbed pork schnitzel in a soft bun with pickles, onion, mustard and mayo, served with crunchy slaw. Cut 600g pork fillet into 4 pieces and pound each to 5mm thin and wider than the bun. Dust in 60g flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 150g crushed crackers mixed with panko. Shallow fry at 180C for 3 minutes a side until golden. Toss shredded cabbage with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and 1 tbsp vinegar. Serve in 4 soft buns with mustard, mayo, pickles and sliced onion and the slaw on the side.
Dill, mustard, egg and celery, for a ball game at dusk
Waxy potatoes dressed warm in mustard and vinegar, then folded with mayo, boiled egg, celery, dill and spring onion.
Seared chicken breast in tarragon cream sauce, potatoes and beans

Pan-roasted chicken breast with a creamy tarragon, white wine and mustard sauce, crispy potatoes and buttered green beans. Roast 800g halved baby potatoes in oil at 220C for 35 minutes. Season 4 chicken breasts with the skin on and sear skin-side down in a hot pan for 5 minutes, flip and roast at 200C for 12 minutes. Rest. Fry 1 diced shallot in the pan, add 100ml white wine and reduce, then 200ml cream, 1 tsp Dijon and 1 tbsp chopped tarragon and simmer 2 minutes. Serve with the potatoes and 300g buttered beans.
Carved at the reception, horseradish cream and roast shallots
Beef fillet seared and roasted pink, rested and sliced, with roast eschalots and a horseradish and chive cream.
Tevye's milk cart doing the rounds while the horse limps along

Thin pancakes rolled around sweet lemon and vanilla cheese, fried golden in butter, with sour cream and warm cherries. Whisk 150g plain flour, 3 eggs, 375ml milk, a pinch of salt and 30g melted butter to a thin batter and rest for 30 minutes. Beat 400g ricotta, 150g soft cream cheese, 1 egg yolk, 2 tbsp caster sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and the zest of 1 lemon until smooth. Simmer 400g frozen pitted cherries with 3 tbsp sugar and the lemon juice for 5 minutes, then thicken with 2 tsp cornflour mixed with a little water. Cook 12 thin pancakes in a lightly buttered 20cm pan, on one side only. Put a spoonful of filling on the cooked side of each, fold in the sides and roll into parcels. Fry in 40g butter, seam side down first, until golden on both sides. Serve 3 each with sour cream and the warm cherries.
Crisp-edged potato and onion bake. Tradition!
Grated potato and onion bound with egg, baked in a hot oiled tin until the edges are dark and crisp.
Cellar trapdoor beef and bean stew
slow-cooked while something knocks under the floor

Fry the bacon in the oil in a heavy pot until crisp, then lift out. Toss 900g beef in the flour and brown in batches in the bacon fat. Soften the onion, carrots, celery and garlic in the same pot. Stir in the tomato paste, then add 750ml beef stock, the thyme, bay, salt, pepper, bacon and beef. Cover and simmer on low. Add the beans and simmer uncovered until thick. Serve in bowls with torn crusty bread.
Cast iron and honey butter. Don't go down to the cellar
Buttermilk cornbread baked in a smoking hot cast iron pan, served with whipped honey butter for the stew.
Smashed beef patties, cheese, onion and pickles on potato buns

Double smashed beef patties with melted cheese, caramelised onion, pickles and a tangy burger sauce in toasted potato buns. Slowly cook 2 sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes until golden. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and 1 tbsp chopped pickles. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. On a very hot barbecue plate, smash each flat, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, add a cheese slice and cook 1 minute. Toast 4 potato buns, spread with sauce and stack 2 patties each with onion and pickles.
Charred corn, tomato, avocado, lime and coriander. Brad made it, of course
Corn cobs charred on the grill, cut off the cob and tossed with tomato, avocado, red onion, coriander and lime.
Butter roast turkey breast glazed with orange cranberry sauce

Roast turkey breast with a sticky cranberry and orange glaze, sage stuffing, roast potatoes and buttery green beans. Rub a 1.5kg turkey breast with 40g butter and salt and roast at 180C for 1 hour 20 minutes. Simmer 150g cranberry sauce with the juice of 1 orange and 1 tbsp honey and brush over for the last 20 minutes. Mix 150g breadcrumbs, 1 fried diced onion, 2 tbsp chopped sage, 1 egg and 30g melted butter and bake in a dish for 30 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes in oil. Toss 300g green beans in butter.
Par-boiled, roughed up and roasted crisp. Precise to the minute
Potatoes par-boiled and shaken rough, roasted in hot oil with garlic and rosemary until shattering crisp.
Baked bread and egg casserole with ham, spinach and gruyère

A baked layered bread and egg pudding with ham, gruyère, spinach and Dijon, puffed and golden on top, ideally kept off the floor. Butter a 2L baking dish. Layer 6 thick slices of day-old bread, torn, with 200g diced ham, 100g wilted baby spinach and 150g grated gruyère. Whisk 6 eggs with 500ml milk, 1 tbsp Dijon, salt and pepper and pour over. Press down, cover and chill for at least 2 hours or overnight. Bake at 180C for 45 minutes until puffed and golden. Rest 10 minutes and serve with tomato relish.
Sybil's lemon and thyme roast chicken
Christmas Eve, every Stone at the table and nobody holding back
Whole chicken roasted over lemon and thyme with garlic butter under the skin, potatoes in the pan juices.
Happy's Subway deal. Teriyaki chicken, salad, sweet onion sauce
Chicken thigh glazed in teriyaki, sliced into a toasted footlong with lettuce, tomato, red onion, cheese and sweet onion sauce.
Beef and pork meatloaf with a tomato glaze, mash and peas
Beef and pork mince mixed lightly with breadcrumbs soaked in milk, grated onion and egg, shaped in a loaf tin, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash and peas.
W: Shortbread base with tart lemon filling, dusted with icing sugar
Buttery shortbread base under a sharp lemon custard, baked until just set and showered with icing sugar.

M: Beef, mushroom, corn and green bean casserole under crisp potato gems
Beef mince browned with onion, mixed with corn, green beans and a creamy mushroom sauce, topped with potato gems and baked at 200C for 35 minutes.
Crisp battered fish, chips and tartare. The team becoming a family
Flathead fillets in a light soda water batter, fried crisp, with oven chips, lemon and quick tartare.
Seared scotch fillet with hash browns, grilled tomato and a fried egg
Seared scotch fillet with a sunny side up egg, hash browns and grilled tomato, casino breakfast at any hour.
Old school, like his training. Dodge, duck, dip, dive and dig in
Chicken, leek, carrot and peas in a creamy thyme sauce under a puff pastry lid, baked golden.
Beef chuck stewed with carrots, onion and potatoes
Beef chuck simmered 3 hours with onion, carrot and potato in stock until thick, ladled into tin bowls with bread.
Peggy Carter and the Strategic Scientific Reserve
Chicken thigh and leek in a creamy white sauce with thyme, under a puff pastry lid.
Grilled bratwurst in rolls with beer onions, sauerkraut and hot mustard

Bratwurst simmered in lager with onions, then charred on the grill and stuffed into toasted rolls with the beer onions, sauerkraut and hot mustard. Put 8 bratwurst in a wide pan with 2 sliced onions, 2 x 375ml cans of lager and 20g butter. Simmer gently for 15 minutes. Lift out the sausages and grill on a hot barbecue for 6 to 8 minutes until charred. Boil the onions in the beer until most of it evaporates and they're sticky. Toast 8 long rolls and fill with a bratwurst, onions, warmed sauerkraut (300g) and hot mustard.
Mustard, dill, celery and spring onion, warm beside the brats
Waxy potatoes tossed warm in a grainy mustard and vinegar dressing with celery, spring onion and dill.
Big Red's Cup day roast beef rolls
Cold roast beef, caramelised onion, rocket, beetroot and horseradish cream

Soft rolls piled with rare roast beef, horseradish cream, caramelised onion, rocket and pickled beetroot, the grand picnic for Cup Day. Rub a 1kg beef eye fillet or rump with oil, salt and pepper, sear all over and roast at 200C for 20 minutes for rare. Rest and chill, then slice thinly. Slowly fry 2 sliced onions in butter for 20 minutes. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish cream. Split 4 soft rolls, spread with horseradish cream and fill with beef, onions, rocket and sliced pickled beetroot.
Cup day picnic chicken and potato salad
Cold roast chook and egg and chive potato salad, on the rug at Flemington
Chicken roasted the day before and served cold in pieces, with a potato salad of egg, chives and mayonnaise.
Parsi family lamb dhansak with brown rice
The dish his mother would have on the table for the whole family
The great Parsi Sunday dish: lamb slow-cooked into a thick, tangy dal of lentils, pumpkin and eggplant, with caramelised brown rice and a sharp kachumber salad.
2 tbsp dhansak masala or garam masala@Spices
Fish in banana leaf with green coconut chutney, from his mother's table
White fish fillets spread with a green chutney of coconut, coriander, mint, chilli and lime, wrapped in banana leaf and steamed.
Crumbed chicken with passata, ham and mozzarella, chips and salad
Crumbed chicken breast topped with tomato sauce, ham and melted cheese, with chips and salad, a proper competition dinner.
Chips, squeaky curds and hot gravy, the Montreal final way
Double-cooked chips under fresh cheese curds and a hot, peppery beef gravy, so the curds just start to melt.
Slow-baked ribs glazed with barbecue sauce, buttered corn and slaw
Sticky barbecue pork ribs basted until glossy, with buttered corn and coleslaw, a big seventies cookout plate.
Grilled thigh and pineapple, sticky teriyaki. Everybody love everybody
Chicken thigh and fresh pineapple threaded and grilled, glazed with teriyaki, finished with sesame and spring onion over rice.

S: Reception fig and goat's cheese crostini
Toasted baguette spread with whipped goat's cheese, topped with fresh fig, honey, thyme and cracked pepper.
Pan fried crab cakes with celery salt and paprika, served with lemon
Crab meat folded with a little mayo, egg, mustard, celery salt, paprika and breadcrumbs, shaped, chilled, pan-fried in butter until golden. Lemon.
Prawn salad with celery and chives in a buttered toasted hot dog bun
Cooked prawns chopped and folded with a little mayo, lemon juice, celery and chives, piled into soft rolls toasted in butter on the cut sides.
Sticky pan fried sausages and golden onions in soft rolls with brown sauce
Pork sausages fried slowly in a heavy pan until sticky, in soft rolls with fried onions and brown sauce.
the Yule Ball in the Great Hall

Warm buckwheat blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, dill, lemon zest and a little salmon roe, laid out on silver trays. Whisk 100g buckwheat flour, 50g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt with 200ml milk and 1 egg into a thick batter. Cook teaspoons in a buttered pan for 1 minute a side to make about 30 blinis. Cool slightly. Top each with a little crème fraîche, a curl of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill, lemon zest and a few beads of salmon roe.
Crisp haloumi glazed with honey and chilli, on toothpicks. Hungarian Horntail heat
Cubes of haloumi fried golden, tossed in honey and fresh chilli, finished with lemon on toothpicks.

M: Eggs, bacon, sausages, hash browns, mushrooms and tomato with toast

A full apocalypse fry-up: crispy bacon, sausages, fried eggs, hash browns, garlic mushrooms and grilled tomatoes with buttered toast. Bake 8 frozen hash browns at 220C for 20 minutes. Fry 8 pork sausages over medium heat for 12 minutes. Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Halve 4 tomatoes, season and fry cut-side down for 3 minutes. Fry 250g sliced mushrooms in 30g butter with 1 crushed garlic clove for 5 minutes. Fry 8 eggs in the bacon fat. Toast 8 slices of bread and butter well. Load up 4 plates and serve with tomato sauce.
Pepperoni, mozzarella and hot honey, before the sinkhole opens
Stretched dough topped with tomato, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked very hot and finished with chilli honey and basil.
Sliders and mac and cheese party plate
Cheeseburger sliders with pickles and baked mac and cheese cups
Little beef sliders and mac and cheese cups, the kind of party food you would hope to find at the most famous party in town.
Isaac's Christmas Eve beef and broccoli
Christmas in New York, the Chinese restaurant way
Rump strips and broccoli stir-fried in a garlic, ginger and oyster sauce glaze, over steamed jasmine rice.
The new patron's steak frites with bearnaise
A gala supper for the young vicomte who pays the bills
The Paris brasserie plate: thick seared sirloin, double-fried chips, peppery watercress and a warm tarragon bearnaise.
Brown butter, lemon and capers, for the masked ball supper
Fish fillets dusted in flour and pan fried in butter until golden, finished with nutty brown butter, lemon, capers and parsley.
dinner at the villa, the children marched in by the bosun's whistle

Beef rump cap simmered with root vegetables in its own broth, apple horseradish, chive sauce and buttered potatoes. Char 1 halved brown onion cut side down in a dry pan until black. Put a 1.5kg beef rump cap in a large pot, cover with 3 litres of cold water, bring to a simmer and skim. Add the onion, 2 carrots, 1 leek, a quarter of a celeriac, 2 bay leaves, 10 peppercorns and 2 tsp salt and simmer very gently, lid ajar, for 2 1/2 hours until tender. Meanwhile boil 800g waxy potatoes until just tender, slice thickly and fry in 50g butter until golden, then toss with parsley. Grate 2 green apples into 3 tbsp horseradish cream and the juice of half a lemon. Mix 200g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp white wine vinegar and a bunch of chopped chives. Rest the beef in the broth for 10 minutes, slice across the grain and serve in shallow bowls with a ladle of broth, the potatoes and both sauces.
One of Maria's favourite things. Veal crumbed thin, buttered noodles
Veal beaten thin, crumbed and fried golden in butter, with egg noodles tossed in butter and parsley, and lemon.
Rump steak with parsley chimichurri and smashed roast potatoes

Thick rump steak chargrilled and sliced, with a sharp parsley and chilli chimichurri, crispy smashed potatoes and a green salad. Boil 1kg baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 30 minutes. Chop a bunch of parsley, 2 garlic cloves and 1 red chilli and mix with 100ml olive oil, 2 tbsp red wine vinegar and dried oregano. Season 1kg rump steak and grill on a very hot barbecue 4 minutes a side for medium rare. Rest 8 minutes, slice and spoon the chimichurri over. Serve with the potatoes and a dressed green salad.
Supper club broccolini with whipped feta
Charred broccolini, whipped feta, chilli and lemon. The new neighbour brought it
Broccolini charred in a hot pan, piled on feta whipped with yoghurt, finished with chilli, lemon zest and olive oil.
Wedding banquet crispy sweet and sour pork
Twice-fried pork with capsicum and pineapple in sweet and sour sauce

Northeast Chinese style crispy pork in a glossy tangy sauce with capsicum, pineapple and carrot, served with steamed jasmine rice. Cut 600g pork scotch fillet into thin slices, season and toss in 1 egg white, then in 100g potato starch. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes, rest, then fry again for 1 minute until very crisp. Stir-fry 1 capsicum, 1 julienned carrot, 2 garlic cloves and 150g pineapple chunks for 2 minutes. Add 4 tbsp rice vinegar, 4 tbsp sugar, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp soy and 1 tsp cornflour in 60ml water and bubble until glossy. Toss in the pork and serve with 300g rice.
Banquet steamed fish with ginger and spring onion
A whole fish at the wedding banquet, so Nai Nai has plenty ahead
Whole snapper steamed over ginger, then dressed with soy and a splash of sizzling oil over shredded spring onion and coriander.

S: the good version, with brown sugar
Oats cooked slowly in milk with a pinch of salt, topped with brown sugar caramelised under the grill and a spoon of cream.
Creamy mushroom and leek pastry cases, plus asparagus wrapped in prosciutto
Vol-au-vent cases filled with mushroom and leek in thyme cream, beside asparagus spears wrapped in prosciutto and roasted.
Stovetop popcorn popped in coconut oil, tossed in melted butter and salt
Pop kernels in coconut oil, toss with melted butter and fine salt while hot, serve in paper cones.
Egg and cress, cucumber cream cheese, and beetroot and dill finger sandwiches
Three fillings on soft white bread, crusts off, cut into fingers: egg and cress, cucumber and cream cheese, beetroot and dill.
Lemon chive crab mayo and cucumber on soft white bread, crusts off

Soft white finger sandwiches of fresh crab in lemony mayonnaise with crisp cucumber and chives, crusts off, the way a seaside hotel does them. Mix 250g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, the zest of 1 lemon, a squeeze of juice, chopped chives and pepper. Butter 8 slices soft white bread with 30g butter. Spread the crab over 4 slices, lay thin slices of 1 Lebanese cucumber on top and close with the remaining bread. Press gently, trim off the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers.

Salmon cured for two days in salt, sugar, dill and white pepper, sliced paper thin onto rye with a sweet mustard and dill sauce. Mix 60g salt, 60g sugar and 1 tsp crushed white pepper. Lay a 600g skin-on salmon fillet in a dish, cover with the cure and a big bunch of chopped dill, wrap tightly and weigh down. Refrigerate 48 hours, turning every 12 hours. Scrape off the cure and slice very thin. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp vinegar, 60ml oil and chopped dill. Serve on 8 slices rye bread.
M: Creamy bright green soup with leek, potato and watercress

Leeks and potato sweated in butter, chicken stock added and simmered 20 minutes, watercress stirred in for 1 minute, blitzed bright green, finished with cream. Sweat 2 sliced leeks and 2 diced potatoes in 40g butter for 10 minutes. Add 1L chicken stock and simmer 20 minutes. Stir in 2 bunches watercress for 1 minute, then blitz until bright green. Finish with 100ml cream.
Hotel Excelsior roast beef and Yorkshires
Sunday lunch in the hotel dining room. Mice not welcome
Beef sirloin roasted pink with roast potatoes, puffed Yorkshire puddings and gravy from the pan.

S: Baked pork and beef meatballs in a sweet chilli and grape jelly glaze

Little pork and beef meatballs baked until browned, then rolled in a sticky sweet chilli and grape jelly glaze and served on toothpicks. Mix 500g pork and beef mince with 1 egg, 40g breadcrumbs, a grated garlic clove and salt. Roll into 30 small balls and bake on a lined tray at 200C for 15 minutes until browned. Simmer 250ml sweet chilli sauce with 150g grape jelly in a wide pan for 5 minutes until glossy. Add the meatballs and turn until coated. Serve hot on toothpicks.
Smoked salmon and dill cream cheese rolled in tortillas and sliced
Soft tortillas spread with dill cream cheese, rolled with smoked salmon and cut into neat pinwheels.
Corn chips layered with smoky black beans and cheddar, baked until melted, topped with jalapeños, sour cream and salsa.

M: Hot dogs under spiced beef chilli and melted cheese

Grilled frankfurts in toasted buns loaded with beef chilli, melted cheddar, diced white onion and yellow mustard, with plenty of napkins. Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tsp chilli powder, 200g tomato passata and 100ml water and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Grill 8 frankfurts for 6 minutes, turning. Toast 8 split hot dog buns. Fill each bun with a frankfurt, spoon over the chilli and top with 120g grated cheddar. Grill 2 minutes until melted, then add diced white onion and a squeeze of mustard.
Honey mustard to dip. Back at school at 27
Chicken tenderloins in a cornflake and parmesan crumb, baked crisp, with a honey mustard dip and carrot sticks.
Roast turkey breast with stuffing, cranberry sauce and roast potatoes
Roast turkey breast with sage stuffing, cranberry sauce and crisp roast potatoes, a proper country inn Christmas dinner.
For the old General, the night the whole division turns up
Leg ham scored and glazed with Vermont maple syrup, mustard and cloves, baked sticky and carved thick.
Spiced lamb skewers on flatbread with garlic yoghurt and chilli butter

Chargrilled lamb kofte spiced with cumin and sumac, on warm flatbread with garlic yoghurt, tomato and onion salad and a drizzle of chilli butter. Mix 600g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp sumac, 1 tsp paprika, chopped parsley and salt. Shape onto 8 skewers and grill 8 minutes, turning. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove. Toss 3 diced tomatoes and 1 sliced red onion with parsley and lemon. Melt 30g butter with 1 tsp chilli flakes. Serve on warm flatbread with yoghurt, salad and chilli butter.
Rice with chicken, almonds and currants, from the hotel kitchen
Chicken thigh browned with onion and cinnamon, cooked with long grain rice in stock, finished with toasted almonds, currants and dill.
Sophie's big night at her mother's hotel
The proper taverna moussaka: roasted eggplant layered with cinnamon-spiced lamb and tomato under a thick, golden white sauce, baked and rested so it cuts clean.
Grilled on the terrace, the summer of 1979
Chicken thigh marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled on skewers and wrapped in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato and onion.

Beef eye fillet roasted to medium rare and sliced on a long platter with roasted red onions, beetroot and a rich, glossy red wine and thyme sauce. Roast 4 beetroot wrapped in foil at 200C for 1 hour, then peel and cut into wedges. Halve 4 red onions and roast with oil and balsamic for 40 minutes. Sear a 1kg eye fillet on all sides and roast at 220C for 20 minutes to medium rare, then rest. Reduce 200ml red wine with 300ml beef stock and thyme until glossy and whisk in 20g butter. Slice and arrange on a long platter.
Red curry prawns with coconut milk, red capsicum and Thai basil. Fuel for the rocket ship
Prawns simmered briefly in red curry and coconut milk with capsicum, finished with Thai basil, over jasmine rice.
Thyme butter roast chicken with potatoes and carrots
Golden roast chicken with herbs, potatoes and carrots, a warm Christmas dinner fit for the future Mrs. Claus.
Pumpkin, carrot and parsnip with maple and thyme, a Council favourite
Pumpkin, carrots and parsnips roasted until caramelised, glazed with maple syrup and thyme, finished with toasted pecans.
Garlic pepper beef rib roast with horseradish sauce

A garlic and pepper crusted beef rib roast, cooked pink, with crisp duck fat potatoes, red wine jus and a sharp horseradish cream. Rub a 2kg beef rib roast with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp cracked pepper, oil and salt. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 50 minutes for medium rare. Rest 20 minutes. Parboil 1.2kg potatoes, rough up, toss in 3 tbsp duck fat and roast 50 minutes. Simmer the pan juices with 200ml red wine and 300ml beef stock until reduced by half. Mix 150g sour cream with 2 tbsp horseradish cream and lemon.
Cream, gruyère and truffle oil. Old money, served in a fortress
Thin potato slices baked slowly in garlic cream with gruyère until golden, finished with a few drops of truffle oil.
carried into the great hall on a board for the whole court

Heat the oven to 200C. Pat the chicken dry, rub with the butter, thyme, salt and pepper and push the lemon halves inside. Toss the carrots, parsnips, onions and garlic with the oil in a roasting tin and sit the chicken on top. Roast for 1 hour. Brush the chicken with the honey and roast until the juices run clear. Rest the chicken on a board and keep the vegetables warm. Stir the flour into the pan juices, whisk in 300ml chicken stock and simmer to a gravy. Carve and serve with the vegetables and gravy.
Great hall roast roots with honey and thyme
Carrots, parsnips and turnips. Shop smart, shop S-Mart
Carrots, parsnips and turnips roasted with honey and thyme until dark at the edges, carried out on the board with the chicken.
The supper served the night Eliza faces the whole of society
The grand English dinner centrepiece: seared beef fillet in mustard, wrapped in mushroom duxelles and puff pastry, baked golden and sliced at the table.
Roasted golden with saffron and garlic. By George, she's got it
Potatoes tossed in saffron butter and garlic, roasted until crisp and golden at the edges.
seafood from the waters around Atlantis

Purge 1kg clams in salted water for 30 minutes. Heat 800ml fish stock with saffron. Fry 3 sliced garlic cloves and a chilli in 3 tbsp olive oil, add 250g cherry tomatoes and cook until collapsing. Toast 300g fregola in the pan for 2 minutes, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time over 12 minutes. Add the clams, cover and cook for 5 minutes until open. Finish with parsley, lemon zest and the rest of the oil.
The island's feast, crackling and potatoes, served at Atlantis
Pork shoulder roasted slow with rosemary, garlic and fennel seed until the crackling shatters, with potatoes in the drippings.

S: Chargrilled eggplant, provolone, warm olives, artichokes, roasted peppers and Italian bread
A board of chargrilled eggplant, sliced provolone, warm olives, marinated artichokes and roasted capsicum with torn Italian bread.
Italian hoagie bites with hot peppers

Long rolls layered with ham, salami, capocollo, provolone, lettuce, tomato and onion, dressed with oil, vinegar and oregano, cut into bites with hot cherry peppers. Split 2 long Italian rolls. Drizzle the insides with olive oil and red wine vinegar and sprinkle with dried oregano. Layer with 100g leg ham, 100g salami, 100g capocollo and 100g provolone. Top with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, thin red onion and chopped hot cherry peppers. Press closed, wrap tightly for 15 minutes, then cut each into 6 bites with a toothpick through each.
Date, oat and peanut butter bites
No-bake date, oat, peanut butter and cocoa balls rolled in coconut
Medjool dates, oats, peanut butter, cocoa and a pinch of salt blitzed in a food processor, rolled into balls and coated in desiccated coconut, chilled an hour.

M: Wall of Gaylord mojo roast pork
Citrus garlic roast pork shoulder with black beans and fried banana

Pork shoulder marinated in garlic, orange, lime and cumin, slow-roasted until tender, with black beans, rice and fried sweet plantain or banana. Blitz 8 garlic cloves, the juice of 2 oranges and 2 limes, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp dried oregano, 60ml olive oil and salt. Rub over a 1.5kg boneless pork shoulder and marinate overnight. Roast covered at 160C for 3 hours, then uncovered at 200C for 30 minutes. Fry 1 onion and 1 capsicum, add 2 drained tins black beans and 1 tsp cumin and simmer 10 minutes. Serve with 300g rice and 2 sliced bananas fried in butter.
Saffron rice, chicken, peas and capsicum, one pot for the whole Focker clan
Chicken thighs browned and cooked in one pot with saffron rice, capsicum, onion, olives and peas.
Chef Didier's duck with orange sauce
Crisp-skinned duck breast with orange honey sauce and potatoes

Crisp-skinned pan-roasted duck breast with a glossy orange and orange liqueur sauce, potatoes fried in duck fat and green beans. Score the skin of 4 duck breasts and season. Place skin-side down in a cold pan and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes to render the fat, then flip and roast at 200C for 6 minutes. Rest. Fry 800g par-boiled diced potatoes in 3 tbsp of the duck fat until crisp. Pour off the rest of the fat, add the juice of 3 oranges, 2 tbsp honey, 30ml orange liqueur and 200ml chicken stock and reduce until glossy. Whisk in 20g butter. Serve with green beans.
Paprika beef braised soft with buttered noodles, Czech comfort at the grand hotel
Beef chuck braised slowly with plenty of onion, sweet paprika and caraway, served with buttered egg noodles and sour cream.
from the Merovingian's kitchen, slow cooked and very French

Season 8 skin-on chicken thigh cutlets and brown in a tbsp of oil in a heavy casserole, then set aside. Fry 150g bacon lardons until crisp, add 30g butter, 12 peeled pickling onions and 300g button mushrooms and colour for 8 minutes, then 2 garlic cloves. Stir in 2 tbsp flour and 1 tbsp tomato paste, pour in 500ml red wine and 250ml chicken stock, add thyme and 2 bay leaves, return the chicken and simmer covered for 35 minutes, then 10 minutes uncovered. Mash 1kg boiled potatoes with 60g butter and 100ml warm milk and serve with the chicken and parsley.
Potatoes baked slow in cream and garlic. Cause and effect
Thin potato slices baked slowly in garlic cream with nutmeg until soft inside and golden on top.

S: Crisp fried balls of shredded beef in a thick creamy filling
Beef braised with onion and thyme until it falls apart, shredded into a thick roux-based ragout, chilled overnight, rolled into balls, crumbed and fried at 180C. Grainy mustard.
Bresaola, burrata, chargrilled zucchini, figs, rocket and olives with breadsticks
Bresaola, burrata, figs, grissini and olives on a board, finished with a drizzle of good olive oil and lemon.
W: Espresso soaked sponge fingers layered with mascarpone cream

Sponge fingers soaked in strong espresso, layered with light mascarpone and whipped cream, set overnight and finished with a heavy dusting of cocoa. Whisk 3 egg yolks with 80g sugar until pale, fold in 500g mascarpone and 200ml whipped cream. Dip 24 sponge fingers in 300ml cooled strong coffee and layer with the cream in a dish. Chill 4 hours or overnight and dust with cocoa.
the crew's canal-side stop in Amsterdam

Caramel stroopwafels warmed over hot espresso until soft and chewy, served with vanilla ice cream drowned in espresso and a drizzle of salted caramel. Brew 4 hot espressos. Rest a stroopwafel on top of each cup for 2 minutes so the caramel softens. Put a scoop of vanilla ice cream in four small glasses. Warm 3 tbsp thick caramel with a pinch of sea salt. Pour an espresso over each scoop, drizzle with caramel and serve with two warm stroopwafels each.

M: Big Nose Kate's chicken and dumplings
A slow pot of chicken and fluffy dumplings, a frontier town supper
Chicken thighs simmered with carrot, celery and onion in a thickened broth, topped with herbed buttermilk dumplings that steam on top.
Beef chuck slow braised with dried chillies, cumin and tomato
Beef chuck diced, browned, braised 3 hours with dried chillies, cumin, garlic and tomato, no beans, Texas style. Cornbread alongside.

S: Pig farm crackling with apple sauce
Munny's struggling pig farm in Kansas

Pork rind scored, salted and dried overnight, roasted hot until blistered and crackling, broken into shards and served with warm spiced apple sauce. Score 600g pork rind every 1cm, rub with 1 tbsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight. Pat dry, lay skin up on a rack and roast at 240C for 30 minutes until puffed and blistered. Meanwhile, simmer 3 peeled, chopped green apples with 2 tbsp brown sugar, a pinch of cinnamon and 3 tbsp water for 10 minutes and mash. Break the crackling into shards and serve with the warm sauce.
Buttermilk cornbread with sweet corn and smoked paprika, baked in a hot skillet
Cornmeal and buttermilk batter with corn kernels and smoked paprika, poured into a hot buttered skillet and baked.
Eggs pickled in vinegar with beets, mustard seeds and peppercorns
Eggs boiled 10 minutes, peeled, pickled 3 days in hot vinegar with beetroot, sugar, mustard seed and peppercorns.
M: Rainy night beef and bean stew
Beef chuck braised with tomatoes, dried chillies and kidney beans
Beef chuck browned, onion, garlic and dried chilli, tomato and beans, braised at 160C for 3 hours until thick.
home on the farm with his children

Thick pork chops seared in cast iron, with apples and onions cooked golden in the same fat and a cider pan sauce, buttery mash and wilted greens. Season 4 thick pork chops and sear in a hot cast iron pan for 4 minutes a side, then rest. Add 20g butter, 2 sliced apples and a sliced onion and cook 8 minutes until golden. Pour in 150ml apple cider and 100ml chicken stock and reduce by half. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Wilt a bunch of silverbeet with garlic. Serve the chops with apples and sauce over the top.
Amish chicken and noodles over mash
Shredded chicken and egg noodles in thick broth, over mashed potato

Tender chicken thighs simmered with thick egg noodles in a rich, peppery broth, spooned over buttery mashed potato with parsley. Simmer 800g chicken thighs in 1.5L chicken stock with 1 diced onion, 2 diced carrots and 2 celery sticks for 35 minutes. Lift out the chicken, shred it and return it to the pot. Add 300g wide egg noodles and simmer 8 minutes until the broth thickens. Season well with salt and plenty of white pepper. Meanwhile boil 1kg peeled potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Ladle the chicken and noodles over the mash and scatter with chopped parsley.
Beef braised soft with carrots and onion, for a barn full of hungry farmhands
Beef chuck seared and braised slowly with onions, carrots and potatoes until it falls apart, gravy from the pot.
Dark roux gumbo with chicken, smoked sausage and okra, served over rice
Chicken and smoked sausage simmered in a dark roux with okra, capsicum, onion and celery, over rice.
Rambeau family honey butter fried chicken
Buttermilk fried chicken with hot honey butter, at Maria's table
Chicken thighs soaked in buttermilk, double-dredged in spiced flour and fried crisp, brushed with hot honey butter.
Red One's training day steak plate
Grilled rump, parsley chimichurri, sweet potato wedges, broccolini

Chargrilled rump with chimichurri, smoky sweet potato wedges and charred broccolini, a high protein dinner for a very fit Santa. Cut 2 large sweet potatoes into wedges, toss with 2 tbsp oil, 1 tsp smoked paprika and salt, and roast at 220C for 30 minutes. Blitz 1 bunch parsley, 2 garlic cloves, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil. Season 800g rump steak and grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side, then rest 5 minutes and slice. Grill 2 bunches broccolini for 4 minutes. Spoon chimichurri over the steak.
Command canteen roast turkey with cranberry
Christmas Eve on duty at North Pole Command, cranberry and gravy
Turkey breast roasted with herb butter under the skin, sliced with cranberry sauce, pan gravy and roast potatoes.
